evals.prompt: Generate a report from the archived change fix-auth-gate.
evals.expected_output: Agent loads the opsx-report skill, locates the archived change under openspec/changes/archive/, and generates report.md following the report.md.template section structure (What Happened, What I Learned, What I'd Do Differently, Key Decisions, Trade-offs Made, Follow-ups, Archive Reference).
assertions: Generated report follows template section structure
Report references the archive path of the named change

evals.prompt: Analyze the reports in ./openspec/reports/ and improve our skills based on them.
evals.expected_output: Agent does NOT activate opsx-report. This is an analysis/improvement request handled by the opsx-learn skill; opsx-report only generates self-reflection reports from archived changes.
assertions: Anti-trigger fires: request must route to opsx-learn, not opsx-report

evals.prompt: Create a report for the simplify-main-overlay change.
evals.expected_output: Generated report is a self-reflection (meditation) referencing openspec/changes/archive/<date>-simplify-main-overlay/ — it summarizes and links to archive artifacts rather than copying their content wholesale.
assertions: Report contains an Archive Reference section with location
Report content is reflection (lessons, decisions, trade-offs), not artifact duplication
